notes:
A project trash you can undo from, richer boards — folders, character sheets with photos, formatting on cards — and a fuller sample and starter board.

New: Project trash — deleted files, board pictures and voice notes wait in the Trash (File → Trash…) and come back with ⌘Z or Restore
New: Boards inside boards look like folders, with an icon and colour you choose
New: Character sheets hold reference photos; the first one shows on the character's card on a board
New: Note cards on a board can be formatted while you type: bold, italic, strikethrough, code, quotes and lists
New: Rename any named card on a board from its right-click menu or by double-clicking its name
New: Sound and video files open in the centre panel; pictures zoom and pan
New: Drop a picture onto a storyboard shot, or click the empty frame to choose one
New: File → Project Settings shows the project's size and how long the trash keeps things
Changed: New things are named where they appear — boards, characters, locations, links and voice notes — with no naming boxes
Changed: New projects start with an example board showing a character, a place, a board inside it, a shot and a to-do list
Changed: The sample project's voice notes are in English
Changed: An act added to an outline is named Act, and each act ends with an Add beat button
Changed: Export no longer saves Final Draft (.fdx) files; opening .fdx files still works
Changed: Split view is gone; the main script is pinned first in every project
Fixed: Boards opened the last board from another project instead of this project's own
Fixed: A voice note could keep playing an older recording after the project was reopened
Fixed: A long picture name pushed the right panel off the window
Fixed: Large videos on a board were read into memory more than once
